name: @simforge-oss/alpamayo-runtime
description: Locally runnable Alpamayo 1 / 1.5 / 2 Super inference services: closed-loop act() over unix-socket MessagePack plus an HTTP facade on the same resident engine.
note: Pins are declared once in src/simforge_alpamayo/families.py and mirrored, with per-file digests, in packages/model-store/models.lock.json. This file is the human-readable summary; the lock is the integrity contract and packages/model-store/src/catalog.ts is what the product displays.

sidecars.note: backbone config/tokenizer (upstream ReasoningVLAConfig default vlm_name_or_path); no weights
image processor + chat template, per upstream helper.BASE_PROCESSOR_NAME
config.json + tokenizer only; all weights come from the Alpamayo checkpoint. This is the ONE gated dependency across the three families and the only reason a user token is ever needed.

quants.bf16: supported (80 GiB; NVIDIA tested only H100 80GB)

alpamayo-2-super.local_execution: qualification-pending — remote/H100-class execution is the only currently supported path

review_gates.card_vs_license: The Alpamayo 1 and 1.5 model cards say "ready for non-commercial use; commercial licensing available upon request" while their LICENSE blob (ec297ac5456384786644013ec196da33b916be97, verified with `git hash-object` against the upstream bytes) is OpenMDW-1.1. The Alpamayo 2 Super card omits that sentence. Which text controls has NOT been decided here; commercial hosting requires a recorded human/legal review. The app shows both texts verbatim and no code asserts a resolution.
review_gates.gated_sidecar: nvidia/Cosmos-Reason2-8B is gated:auto under the NVIDIA Open Model License. Its metadata is public but its file content requires an accepted licence and a token, which is why the lock pins those files by upstream git blob id rather than by a downloaded hash.
review_gates.parity_dataset: Upstream parity scripts for all three families stream nvidia/PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles, which is gated:auto under a 12-month non-redistributable licence. Parity runs therefore need a user token with dataset acceptance; we cannot ship golden clips, and only parity OUTPUTS may be cached.

assets.policy: No weights in the repository, in a container image, or in a release asset. Code references them by pinned revision and per-file digest.
